# Copilot Instructions

Here you will find information regarding how to use GitHub Copilot effectively. 
- Install the GitHub Copilot extension in your IDE.
- Use natural language comments to guide Copilot in generating code. 
- Review and modify the suggestions provided by Copilot as needed.

## Tips
- Experiment with different prompts to see how Copilot responds.
- Remember to validate the generated code for security and performance.
